renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: What is the highest thing, that gives Kaula success all by itself? Even a touch of truly knowing it lifts you level with the sky-going Power. Tell me the most secret secret, Lord — the Power living in the heart, mistress of the clan. Tell me about her, so I become full.
Listen, blessed Goddess: even the answer has something beyond it. I will tell it, no doubt — it works fast. This Kaula rite lives in my heart-sky.

First the vowels, all moon-days ending in the dot; inside them, moon and sun are named through time. Realities from earth to person sit five-by-five in ka-to-ma sound groups. Fourfold holds of wind, fire, water; above, the famous sha-row, and the five spirit-chiefs.

Rootless, rightly ordered, ending in ksha — this is how things unfold, told for all mantras and wisdoms. This is the womb, told in every Tantra for all time — joined with the fourteen, ending with the moon-lord, the third godhead, the heart of Bhairava himself.
